body:
Selection and notes work on the Architecture tab as they do on UI/UX: a human can point at a flow diagram's nodes and its edges.

### Do

- Clicking a node or an edge selects it by its ID, and a dragged region selects the nodes and edges inside it, with the same rules as the UI/UX tab.
- A note on the Architecture tab sends through the same path as on UI/UX.

This assumes edges can be pointed at as well as nodes, since both are elements (feature:afd9fe8bae36c59c). If the human says otherwise, select nodes only.

### Acceptance

- Tests: a node and an edge each select by ID, and a region selects the expected nodes and edges.
- Update the README.

### Left out

Sequence diagrams and other diagram types.
title: notes: point at diagram nodes and edges
